entries: **Antigravity days in the snapshot now show the corrected token totals.** Before this fix, the daily snapshot replaced a saved day only if the new total was at least as large. Antigravity days saved before the token-counting fix were too high, so the smaller corrected totals never replaced them, in reports or in the snapshot file. The snapshot now records which counting version produced each day. It replaces an old Antigravity day only when every session and every other tool's records from that day are still on disk. The year ledger updates that day only after the snapshot has replaced it, and reports no longer add the old difference back from the ledger.

**CSV exports no longer drop the 10th project when old total-only records exist.** The project CSV export took the top 10 rows first and set aside old total-only records second. Those records took one of the 10 places, so the 10th project was left out. The export now sets aside old total-only records first and then takes the top 10 projects, the same way the report chart does. The old records get their own row at the end.

**Usage with no project name shows as "unknown", not "Old records (totals only)".** When Codex can't find a session's working directory, it records the project as `unknown`. The report treated every `unknown` project as old total-only history. The report and its filter now check whether a row came from the old total-only ledger. Only those rows are labeled "Old records (totals only)"; current usage with no project shows as "unknown".

**Generating a report no longer erases days that background updates just saved to the year ledger.** The year ledger was protected only by a lock inside a single process. When the report ran in a separate process, the report and the background updates could write the ledger at the same time, and one write could erase days the other had just saved or backfilled. usage now creates a lock file next to `year_ledger.json`, so only one process at a time can read, merge, and write the ledger. If another process holds the lock for more than 10 seconds, usage skips this update and tries again later. It never writes without the lock.

**usage no longer sends a Muse "restored" notification just because the reset time passed.** For Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity, usage sends nothing when the reset time passes; it waits for a new reading. For Muse, it treated the 0% shown after the reset as a real reading. So when Muse sat idle and was not checked again, usage sent a "restored" notification on macOS and Windows. usage now handles Muse the same way as the other tools.

**Quota-aware mode no longer repeats a warning when the reset estimate moves earlier.** If the estimated reset time moved more than ten minutes earlier, usage treated it as a new window and sent the same warning again. This happened, for example, when Antigravity switched between its two quota sources. Now, as long as your usage stays at the level you were already warned about, you won't get the warning again, whichever way the estimate moves.

**Turning on the status line with only the Grok CLI installed no longer reports a failure.** usage installed the Grok status line, but the switch still showed an error because it found neither Claude Code nor Codex. It now reports success once the Grok status line is set up.

**Muse readings use the time Muse's server checked the quota.** When usage read an old allowance again, the reading could look new. The Muse card and the status line now use the server's check time to decide on the stale notice and to show the reading's age.

**Quota-aware mode shows how old a reused Claude Code reading is.** When the status line redrew, an old reading could look current. usage now records a separate reading time for each quota window, so a fresh five-hour reading no longer shows the weekly reading's age. The status line hook updates to 1.21 and the quota-aware hook to 1.19.
**Repairing the resume hook keeps newer scripts.** When the prompt file goes missing, usage restores it and leaves a newer installed script in place.

**All-time reports include earlier Claude Code activity.** The report used to start on the first day with token usage, so it left out earlier days that had activity but no token records. It now starts on the earliest day with either, and the date picker can select that day.

**A Codex quota rejection now applies only to its own quota.** When a dedicated quota such as Codex Spark was rejected more recently than the general Codex quota, usage hid the general rejection and showed the general window below 100%. usage now keeps the latest rejection for each quota and applies it only to the matching window.

**New Codex models are announced only once.** If a model showed up in usage logs first, usage announced it, then announced it again in the same conversation when the model later appeared in the Codex model list. usage now reuses the first record and keeps its first-seen time.

**GPT-6.2 Sol and GPT-6.2 Astra have prices when offline.** When the price table could not be downloaded, usage counted Codex's new GPT-6.2 models at $0. The built-in fallback price table now includes them: Sol $2 / $10 and Astra $8 / $40 per million input / output tokens.

**Report exports are named after the dates they cover.** HTML, CSV, and PNG exports used to be named after the day you exported them. If you opened a filtered export months later, you couldn't tell from the file name which period it covered. Files are now named like `usage-report-2026-10-01_2026-11-17.csv`. Reports without a date picker still use the export date. An exported HTML report reopens at the same dates.

**Token Saver's rules against analogies, emoji, and decorative tables now apply only to Claude's own replies.** Articles, posts, and slides you ask Claude to write no longer have to follow them. If you ask for a post full of analogies, you no longer run into a conflict with Token Saver.

**Token Saver no longer allows a short reply to call unverified work done.** After Claude edits files or runs commands, its reply now says what it verified, and says plainly when work is untested or only partly done. Claude writes out unverified assumptions and open risks in full. Teaching rules in your CLAUDE.md, a request for an analogy, or saying you don't follow now take priority over keeping replies short. The rule against made-up abbreviations also no longer says that abbreviations save no tokens, because there was no evidence for that.

title.zh-TW: 報表與年度帳本的歷史紀錄更準確
title.en: More accurate history in reports and the year ledger

body.zh-TW:
翻開歷史報表核對用量，現在不用擔心數字卡在舊紀錄或被覆蓋。

Antigravity 計數修正前存下的舊日子，token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）總數偏高，過去因為快照只在新數字不小於舊紀錄時才替換而換不進去。現在快照會記下計數版次，只要當天所有工作階段與其他工具紀錄還在本機，就換成修正數字。年度帳本等快照換好才更新，報表也不再補回舊差額。

報表與背景更新在不同行程同時寫入 `year_ledger.json` 時，過去會互相蓋掉剛存下或補回的日子。現在帳本旁會建鎖檔，一次只讓一個行程讀取、合併並寫回。別的行程佔鎖超過 10 秒就跳過等下次補，沒拿到鎖不寫入。

「全部」報表過去從有 token 用量的第一天起算，漏掉更早只有活躍紀錄的日子。現在改從最早有用量或活躍紀錄那天開始，日期篩選器也選得到。
body.en:
When checking past usage in historical reports, you no longer have to worry about numbers getting stuck on old records or overwritten.

Old Antigravity days saved before the counting fix had inflated token (text units AI processes and bills by) totals, which could not be replaced before because the snapshot only swapped in a new number when it was at least as large as the old one. Now the snapshot records the counting version and swaps in the corrected number as long as all sessions and other tool records from that day are still on disk. The year ledger waits until the snapshot finishes replacing the day before updating, and reports no longer add back the old difference.

When a report and a background update ran in separate processes and wrote to `year_ledger.json` at the same time, they could overwrite days the other had just saved or backfilled. Now a lock file is created next to the ledger so only one process at a time can read, merge, and write it back. If another process holds the lock for more than 10 seconds, this update is skipped for later, and nothing is written without the lock.

The "All-time" report used to start from the first day with token usage, leaving out earlier days that only had activity records. It now starts from the earliest day with either usage or activity records, and the date picker can select that day too.

items.original:
**Antigravity days in the snapshot now show the corrected token totals.** Before this fix, the daily snapshot replaced a saved day only if the new total was at least as large. Antigravity days saved before the token-counting fix were too high, so the smaller corrected totals never replaced them, in reports or in the snapshot file. The snapshot now records which counting version produced each day. It replaces an old Antigravity day only when every session and every other tool's records from that day are still on disk. The year ledger updates that day only after the snapshot has replaced it, and reports no longer add the old difference back from the ledger.
**Generating a report no longer erases days that background updates just saved to the year ledger.** The year ledger was protected only by a lock inside a single process. When the report ran in a separate process, the report and the background updates could write the ledger at the same time, and one write could erase days the other had just saved or backfilled. usage now creates a lock file next to `year_ledger.json`, so only one process at a time can read, merge, and write the ledger. If another process holds the lock for more than 10 seconds, usage skips this update and tries again later. It never writes without the lock.
**All-time reports include earlier Claude Code activity.** The report used to start on the first day with token usage, so it left out earlier days that had activity but no token records. It now starts on the earliest day with either, and the date picker can select that day.

title.zh-TW: 專案分類與報表匯出檔名更清楚
title.en: Clearer project labels and report export file names

body.zh-TW:
匯出專案排行或翻找幾個月前的報表檔案，標籤和檔名常讓人一頭霧水。

匯出專案 CSV 過去先取前 10 名才挑出只剩總數的舊紀錄，第 10 名專案會被擠掉。現在比照報表畫面先挑出舊紀錄，列在最後一列，再取前 10 名專案。

Codex 找不到工作階段的工作資料夾時，會把專案記成 `unknown`，過去報表一律當成舊紀錄。現在報表和網頁篩選器會檢查資料是否來自舊帳本，是才標成「舊紀錄（只剩總數）」，其餘無名稱的用量顯示「未知」。

HTML、CSV 和 PNG 匯出檔過去用匯出當天命名，隔幾個月重開看不出資料期間。現在改用涵蓋日期命名，像 `usage-report-2026-10-01_2026-11-17.csv`，無日期篩選器的報表仍用匯出日。匯出的 HTML 重開時也會停在同一段日期。
body.en:
Exporting project rankings or digging up report files from months ago used to leave you guessing at labels and file names.

Project CSV exports used to take the top 10 rows before setting aside old total-only records, which pushed out the 10th project. Now, matching the report view, old records are set aside first and placed in the last row before taking the top 10 projects.

When Codex cannot find a session's working directory, it records the project as `unknown`, which reports used to treat as old records across the board. Now the report and web filter check whether the data came from the old ledger: only those rows are labeled "Old records (totals only)", while other unnamed usage shows as "unknown".

HTML, CSV, and PNG exports used to be named after the export date, making it hard to tell which period they covered when reopened months later. They are now named after the covered dates, such as `usage-report-2026-10-01_2026-11-17.csv`, while reports without a date picker still use the export date. Reopening an exported HTML file also stays on those same dates.

items.original:
**CSV exports no longer drop the 10th project when old total-only records exist.** The project CSV export took the top 10 rows first and set aside old total-only records second. Those records took one of the 10 places, so the 10th project was left out. The export now sets aside old total-only records first and then takes the top 10 projects, the same way the report chart does. The old records get their own row at the end.
**Usage with no project name shows as "unknown", not "Old records (totals only)".** When Codex can't find a session's working directory, it records the project as `unknown`. The report treated every `unknown` project as old total-only history. The report and its filter now check whether a row came from the old total-only ledger. Only those rows are labeled "Old records (totals only)"; current usage with no project shows as "unknown".
**Report exports are named after the dates they cover.** HTML, CSV, and PNG exports used to be named after the day you exported them. If you opened a filtered export months later, you couldn't tell from the file name which period it covered. Files are now named like `usage-report-2026-10-01_2026-11-17.csv`. Reports without a date picker still use the export date. An exported HTML report reopens at the same dates.

title.zh-TW: 額度讀數時效與提醒不再誤報
title.en: Accurate quota reading ages and no more false alerts

body.zh-TW:
看終端機底下的狀態列與額度提示，讀數新舊和警告現在不再亂跳。

Muse 過重置時間若沒重讀，過去把 0% 當真在 macOS 與 Windows 跳「已恢復」通知，現在改等新讀數。

Muse 卡片與狀態列改用伺服器查額度時間判斷過期與年齡，重讀舊額度不再像剛查的。

重置估計提前超過 10 分鐘時（如切換額度來源），只要用量停在已警告程度，額度感知模式就不重複警告。

Claude Code 替各時段分開記讀取時間，五小時額度不再顯示週額度舊時間。狀態列 hook（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）升到 1.21，額度感知為 1.19。

Codex 替各額度保留最新拒絕只套用到對應時段，Codex Spark 較晚被拒時，不再藏起一般額度拒絕。
body.en:
Checking the status line at the bottom of your terminal and quota prompts, reading ages and warnings no longer jump around.

When Muse passed its reset time without a fresh reading, it used to treat 0% as real and trigger a "restored" notification on macOS and Windows; it now waits for a new reading.

The Muse card and status line now use the server's quota check time to judge staleness and age, so re-reading an old quota no longer looks freshly checked.

When the reset estimate moves earlier by more than 10 minutes (such as when switching quota sources), quota-aware mode no longer repeats the warning as long as usage stays at an already-warned level.

Claude Code now records a separate reading time for each window, so the five-hour quota no longer shows the weekly quota's old timestamp. The status line hook (a small program triggered by specific events) updates to 1.21, and quota-aware updates to 1.19.

Codex now keeps the latest rejection for each quota and applies it only to the matching window, so a newer Codex Spark rejection no longer hides a general quota rejection.

**usage no longer sends a Muse "restored" notification just because the reset time passed.** For Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity, usage sends nothing when the reset time passes; it waits for a new reading. For Muse, it treated the 0% shown after the reset as a real reading. So when Muse sat idle and was not checked again, usage sent a "restored" notification on macOS and Windows. usage now handles Muse the same way as the other tools.
**Quota-aware mode no longer repeats a warning when the reset estimate moves earlier.** If the estimated reset time moved more than ten minutes earlier, usage treated it as a new window and sent the same warning again. This happened, for example, when Antigravity switched between its two quota sources. Now, as long as your usage stays at the level you were already warned about, you won't get the warning again, whichever way the estimate moves.
**Muse readings use the time Muse's server checked the quota.** When usage read an old allowance again, the reading could look new. The Muse card and the status line now use the server's check time to decide on the stale notice and to show the reading's age.
**Quota-aware mode shows how old a reused Claude Code reading is.** When the status line redrew, an old reading could look current. usage now records a separate reading time for each quota window, so a fresh five-hour reading no longer shows the weekly reading's age. The status line hook updates to 1.21 and the quota-aware hook to 1.19.
**A Codex quota rejection now applies only to its own quota.** When a dedicated quota such as Codex Spark was rejected more recently than the general Codex quota, usage hid the general rejection and showed the general window below 100%. usage now keeps the latest rejection for each quota and applies it only to the matching window.

body.zh-TW: 續談用的提示檔不見了，想跑修復卻怕蓋掉後來裝好的新版程式。現在修復續談 hook 時，usage 只會把遺失的提示檔補回來，已安裝的較新腳本會原封不動留在原地。
body.en: If your resume prompt file went missing, you might hesitate to run a repair for fear of overwriting a newer script installed later. Now when repairing the resume hook, usage only restores the missing prompt file and leaves any newer installed script untouched.

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式不限制創作且誠實交代驗證
title.en: Token Saver unblocks creative writing and reports verification honestly

body.zh-TW:
開啟精簡模式省字數，過去常連帶綁住創作內容或讓回覆過度簡略。

「不用比喻、表情符號、裝飾性表格」這幾條規定現在只管 Claude 自己的回覆。你請它寫的文章、貼文或簡報不用遵守，要它寫一篇滿是比喻的貼文也不會再跟精簡模式衝突。

改檔或跑指令後，短回覆不能再把沒驗證的事說成做完了。Claude 現在會交代驗證了什麼，沒測過或只做一部分會直說，也會把沒驗證的假設與還沒解決的風險寫完整。如果你的 `CLAUDE.md` 有教學規則、你要求用比喻或說看不懂，這些都優先於精簡；「不要自創縮寫」也拿掉了「縮寫省不到 token」這句沒有證據的說法。

⟦就像請秘書平時用條列快報進度，他自己的工作匯報會力求精短、沒確認完的事也老實標出來，但替你代筆的活動致詞稿仍會保留比喻和圖表。⟧
body.en:
Turning on Token Saver to save words used to restrict creative writing as well or make replies overly terse.

The rules against analogies, emoji, and decorative tables now apply only to Claude's own replies. Articles, posts, or slides you ask it to write do not have to follow them, so asking for a post full of analogies will no longer conflict with Token Saver.

After editing files or running commands, short replies can no longer claim unverified work is done. Claude now states what it verified, says plainly when something is untested or only partly done, and writes out unverified assumptions and open risks in full. If your `CLAUDE.md` has teaching rules, or if you ask for analogies or say you do not follow, those take priority over brevity; the rule against made-up abbreviations also drops the unsupported claim that abbreviations save no tokens.

⟦Think of a secretary who normally gives you bullet-point progress updates: his own work reports stay brief and flag anything unverified, while the event speeches he drafts for you still keep their analogies and charts.⟧

items.original:
**Token Saver's rules against analogies, emoji, and decorative tables now apply only to Claude's own replies.** Articles, posts, and slides you ask Claude to write no longer have to follow them. If you ask for a post full of analogies, you no longer run into a conflict with Token Saver.
**Token Saver no longer allows a short reply to call unverified work done.** After Claude edits files or runs commands, its reply now says what it verified, and says plainly when work is untested or only partly done. Claude writes out unverified assumptions and open risks in full. Teaching rules in your CLAUDE.md, a request for an analogy, or saying you don't follow now take priority over keeping replies short. The rule against made-up abbreviations also no longer says that abbreviations save no tokens, because there was no evidence for that.

entries: **The Windows tray tooltip no longer lists a tool you hid under Hide Sections.** Claude and Codex were always listed, even when hidden, and their lines could push the last tools past Windows' 127-character tooltip limit. A hidden tool's line is now left out; the tool chosen as Tray Display Source stays, because the icon shows its number.

**Menu bar icons are visible again on a dark menu bar.** The Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, and Muse icons were drawn black even when the menu bar was dark, so on macOS Tahoe they disappeared against it. They now follow the menu bar's text color in light and dark. Reported in #352.

**The Antigravity card no longer goes stale when only its weekly reading is carried over.** When the weekly reading could not be refreshed, the whole card was marked stale, which stopped the 5-hour burn rate, notifications, and the window keeper. Now only the weekly row shows its age, and the 5-hour row keeps working.

**Quota notifications no longer use a reading from before the window reset.** After the reset time passed, the old percentage could still send a "used up" notification or block the next window's notifications. On macOS and Windows, a window past its reset time now ends quietly.
**Projects that use only unpriced models show "—" instead of $0.00 in the report,** including after date filtering.
**The Windows tray now reports a failed status line toggle or hook install** instead of failing silently.
**GPT-OSS, which Antigravity retires on 2026-11-18, was removed from the Claude and GPT model group,** and Antigravity group models with hyphenated names now match your usage logs.
**Gemini 4 Carbon now shows as "Carbon 4".**

**Switching to an account without a 5-hour limit no longer keeps the previous account's 5-hour usage.** The status line and quota-aware mode filled the missing window from the old account, so they could show 99% used on an account that has no 5-hour limit. A missing window is now filled only from the same account. The status-line hook updates to 1.19 and the quota-aware hook to 1.17.

**The status line switch shows as on when only Grok uses it beside your own Claude Code status line.** It showed as off, and turning it on installed the status line again instead of turning Grok's off.
**Quota-aware mode no longer announces a Codex model a second time when you first use it.** A model already recorded from the Codex catalog was announced again from your usage logs.

**New Antigravity models are announced even when every model in the first scan was already known from other tools.** usage did not record that Antigravity had been scanned, so later new models were treated as part of the first scan and not announced.

**The offline check works when NO_PROXY excludes Google.** With a proxy set, usage assumed it was online even when Google's sign-in host bypassed the proxy, so it could run the Antigravity CLI while offline and mark you as signed out.
**Offline prices for Claude Mythos 5 and Mythos 5.2 were added,** and the price-table check now covers Mythos models.

**A refusal from a separate Codex limit no longer shows your regular Codex quota as 100% used.** When a dedicated limit such as Codex Spark or a premium model refused a request, the card marked the regular weekly window as full. Only a refusal of the regular Codex limit does that now.

**Reopening an old Codex session no longer hides newer quota from your other sessions.** After a refusal in a resumed old session, the card kept that session's old reading and skipped newer readings from other sessions. It now takes the newest reading, then applies the refusal.

**The Codex disk cache is no longer rewritten on every refresh when you have forked or subagent sessions.** Those sessions were dropped each time the cache was saved, so the cache was rewritten and they were read again.

**Opening the report no longer leaves the menu bar or tray app about 150 MB larger.** The report was built inside the app, which loaded your full history a second time and kept that memory until restart. It is now built in a separate process that frees the memory when it exits.

**The report is built faster.** It reads Claude Code logs once instead of twice and no longer runs git for project folders that were deleted. On one large history it went from 47 to 32 seconds, with identical numbers.

**Days you used Claude Code count as active in the report even when their conversation files are gone.** Claude Code deletes conversation files after 30 days by default, so those days counted as idle and broke your streak. Active days and streaks now count them, and the heatmap shows them in its lightest shade. The appendix, now titled "How the numbers are calculated", lists those dates under "Usage not included".

**Older Antigravity history no longer lists one model twice or leaves it unpriced in the report.** History saved before model IDs were cleaned up kept raw IDs such as `gemini-3.8-flash-n`, which left billions of tokens priced at $0. They are now merged with the clean name and priced.

**Usage saved only as daily totals no longer ranks as your top project or tool.** Usage from before August 2026 has no project or tool, and the report listed it as the top "unknown" project and tool at $0.00. It now shows as a grey "Old records (totals only)" row at the bottom with an unknown cost, and the trend legend uses the same name. Percentages are unchanged.
**Dispatch conversations started with a slash command get a real title in the report** instead of text like "<local-command-caveat>The command below".
**The Antigravity status line shows the Argon quota for Gemini 4 Argon and Orchestrator (Argon).** It showed the Claude and GPT group or the Gemini group instead.

**Auto-start 5-hour Session is renamed Auto-start 5-hour timer.** It sat under Launch at login and read like a second launch option; it starts the 5-hour timer right after a reset. Behavior and settings are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣提示不列隱藏工具
title.en: Windows tray tooltip drops hidden tools

body.zh-TW: 滑鼠移到 Windows 系統匣圖示上，想看各工具額度卻發現排在後面的不見了。過去即使你在「隱藏區塊」藏起 Claude 和 Codex，提示文字仍會硬塞這兩行，把後面的工具擠出 Windows 的 127 字元上限。現在被隱藏的工具不會再出現。唯一保留的是選為「系統匣顯示來源」的工具，因為圖示上顯示的正是它的數字。
body.en: Hovering over the Windows tray icon to check each tool's quota used to cut off the tools at the end. Even when you hid Claude and Codex under Hide Sections, the tooltip still crammed in their lines and pushed the last tools past Windows' 127-character limit. Hidden tools are now left out. The only one kept is the tool chosen as Tray Display Source, because the icon shows its number.

items.original: **The Windows tray tooltip no longer lists a tool you hid under Hide Sections.** Claude and Codex were always listed, even when hidden, and their lines could push the last tools past Windows' 127-character tooltip limit. A hidden tool's line is now left out; the tool chosen as Tray Display Source stays, because the icon shows its number.

title.zh-TW: macOS 深色選單列圖示恢復可見
title.en: macOS dark menu bar icons are visible again

body.zh-TW: 把 macOS Tahoe 螢幕最上方調成暗色外觀後，原本掛在那裡的幾個工具小標誌是不是直接隱形了？之前 Claude、Codex、Antigravity、Grok 與 Muse 的圖示一律畫成黑色，換成深色背景就整個融進去。現在圖示會跟著選單列的文字顏色走，淺色或深色都能看清楚。
body.en: After switching the top bar on macOS Tahoe to a dark appearance, did the small tool icons sitting there seem to vanish? Previously, the Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, and Muse icons were always drawn in black, so they blended right into a dark background. They now follow the menu bar's text color, staying clear in both light and dark modes.

items.original: **Menu bar icons are visible again on a dark menu bar.** The Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, and Muse icons were drawn black even when the menu bar was dark, so on macOS Tahoe they disappeared against it. They now follow the menu bar's text color in light and dark. Reported in #352.

title.zh-TW: 5 小時額度與通知不被舊讀數拖累
title.en: 5-hour quotas and alerts stay unaffected by old readings

body.zh-TW:
5 小時窗口照理說各自獨立計算，之前只要遇上過期或重置的舊數字，卡片和通知卻常跟著亂套。

Antigravity 週額度更新失敗、只能沿用舊讀數時，過去整張卡會被標成過期，5 小時的燃燒率、通知與窗口保持功能全都停住。現在只有週額度那一列顯示資料放了多久，5 小時那一列照常運作。

額度通知也不再拿重置前的讀數來判斷。過了重置時間後，舊百分比以前還可能發出「已用完」通知，或把下一個窗口的通知擋掉。現在 macOS 與 Windows 上，過了重置時間的窗口都會安靜結束。⟦月票過期本來不該影響買單程票進站，以前舊數字一過期卻把單程閘門也鎖住，現在各算各的互不干擾。⟧
body.en:
Each 5-hour window is supposed to be calculated on its own, yet stale or pre-reset numbers used to throw off both the card and notifications.

When Antigravity failed to refresh its weekly quota and had to carry over an old reading, the entire card was marked stale, stopping the 5-hour burn rate, notifications, and the window keeper. Now only the weekly row shows how old the data is, while the 5-hour row keeps working.

Quota notifications also stop using readings from before a window reset. Past the reset time, an old percentage could still trigger a "used up" alert or block notifications for the next window. On both macOS and Windows, any window past its reset time now ends quietly. ⟦An expired monthly pass should not stop you from buying a single-ride ticket, yet an expired old number used to lock the single-ride gate as well—now each runs on its own without getting in the way.⟧

items.original:
**The Antigravity card no longer goes stale when only its weekly reading is carried over.** When the weekly reading could not be refreshed, the whole card was marked stale, which stopped the 5-hour burn rate, notifications, and the window keeper. Now only the weekly row shows its age, and the 5-hour row keeps working.
**Quota notifications no longer use a reading from before the window reset.** After the reset time passed, the old percentage could still send a "used up" notification or block the next window's notifications. On macOS and Windows, a window past its reset time now ends quietly.

title.zh-TW: 報表未定價與舊紀錄不再誤標 $0
title.en: Unpriced and old report entries no longer show $0

body.zh-TW:
打開報表看到好幾個專案寫著 $0.00，還有一筆「unknown」排在榜首，很容易誤以為沒花到錢或這項目最燒額度。

只用到未定價模型的專案，現在一律改顯示橫線而不是 $0.00，套用日期篩選後也一樣。

模型 ID 整理前留下的舊 Antigravity 歷史，曾保有像 `gemini-3.8-flash-n` 這類原始 ID。這讓同個模型在報表被列兩次，數十億個 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）也被算成 $0。現在這批紀錄會併回整理後的名稱並計價。

2026 年 8 月以前只存下每日總量的用量沒有專案和工具資料，以前被當成「unknown」以 $0.00 排第一。現在它改成排在最底下灰色的「舊紀錄（只剩總數）」，金額顯示未知，趨勢圖圖例也用同一個名稱，百分比不變。
body.en:
Opening the report to find several projects listed at $0.00 and an "unknown" entry at the top makes it easy to think nothing was spent or that it burned the most quota.

Projects that use only unpriced models now show "—" instead of $0.00, including after date filtering.

Older Antigravity history saved before model IDs were cleaned up kept raw IDs such as `gemini-3.8-flash-n`. That caused the same model to appear twice in the report and left billions of tokens (the text units AI processes and bills for) priced at $0. Those records are now merged into the clean name and priced.

Usage saved only as daily totals before August 2026 has no project or tool data, and it used to rank first as "unknown" at $0.00. It now appears at the bottom as a grey "Old records (totals only)" row with an unknown cost, and the trend legend uses the same name while percentages stay unchanged.

items.original:
**Projects that use only unpriced models show "—" instead of $0.00 in the report,** including after date filtering.
**Older Antigravity history no longer lists one model twice or leaves it unpriced in the report.** History saved before model IDs were cleaned up kept raw IDs such as `gemini-3.8-flash-n`, which left billions of tokens priced at $0. They are now merged with the clean name and priced.
**Usage saved only as daily totals no longer ranks as your top project or tool.** Usage from before August 2026 has no project or tool, and the report listed it as the top "unknown" project and tool at $0.00. It now shows as a grey "Old records (totals only)" row at the bottom with an unknown cost, and the trend legend uses the same name. Percentages are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列開關與跨帳號用量不再錯亂
title.en: Status line switch and cross-account usage stop mixing up

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 點了狀態列沒反應，或是換完帳號發現額度百分比還停在舊帳號那邊。

在 Windows 系統匣切換狀態列或安裝 hook（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）失敗時，現在會直接跳出錯誤提示，不再悄悄沒反應。

換到沒有 5 小時額度的帳號後，狀態列與額度感知模式不再沿用前一個帳號的 5 小時用量。以前這兩個功能會拿舊帳號數字補缺口，讓原本沒有 5 小時額度的帳號顯示成 99% 已用。現在只會用同一個帳號的資料補窗口，狀態列 hook 已更新為 1.19，額度感知 hook 更新為 1.17。

當你讓 Claude Code 用自己的狀態列、只留 Grok 用 usage 的狀態列時，開關現在會正確顯示為開啟。原本它會顯示關閉，按下去反而重新安裝狀態列，而不是關掉 Grok 那邊。
body.en:
Clicking the status line in Windows could do nothing, or switching accounts could leave your quota percentage stuck on the old account.

When toggling the status line or installing a hook (a small program triggered by specific events) fails in the Windows tray, it now shows an error instead of failing silently.

After switching to an account without a 5-hour limit, the status line and quota-aware mode no longer carry over the previous account's 5-hour usage. They used to fill the missing window with numbers from the old account, making an account with no 5-hour limit show 99% used. A missing window is now filled only from the same account, with the status-line hook updated to 1.19 and the quota-aware hook to 1.17.

When Claude Code uses its own status line and only Grok uses usage's status line, the switch now correctly shows as on. It previously showed as off, and clicking it reinstalled the status line instead of turning Grok's off.

items.original:
**The Windows tray now reports a failed status line toggle or hook install** instead of failing silently.
**Switching to an account without a 5-hour limit no longer keeps the previous account's 5-hour usage.** The status line and quota-aware mode filled the missing window from the old account, so they could show 99% used on an account that has no 5-hour limit. A missing window is now filled only from the same account. The status-line hook updates to 1.19 and the quota-aware hook to 1.17.
**The status line switch shows as on when only Grok uses it beside your own Claude Code status line.** It showed as off, and turning it on installed the status line again instead of turning Grok's off.

title.zh-TW: 新舊模型分組與 Mythos 離線定價對齊
title.en: Model groups and Mythos offline pricing aligned

body.zh-TW:
各家模型改名、退場或出新版時，清單跟價目表沒跟著動就容易對不上用量。

Antigravity 將於 2026-11-18 下架 GPT-OSS，它已從 Claude 與 GPT 模型群組拿掉。名稱帶有連字號的 Antigravity 群組模型，現在也對得上你的用量紀錄。

Gemini 4 Carbon 在介面上的顯示名稱調整為「Carbon 4」。

使用 Gemini 4 Argon 與 Orchestrator (Argon) 期間，Antigravity 狀態列會顯示 Argon 額度。原本它只會顯示 Claude 與 GPT 群組或 Gemini 群組。

價目表這邊也補上了 Claude Mythos 5 與 Mythos 5.2 的離線價格，價目表檢查同步涵蓋 Mythos 模型。
body.en:
When models are renamed, retired, or newly released, usage stops matching up if the lists and price table fall behind.

GPT-OSS, which Antigravity retires on 2026-11-18, has been removed from the Claude and GPT model group. Antigravity group models with hyphenated names now also match your usage logs.

Gemini 4 Carbon now displays in the interface as "Carbon 4".

While using Gemini 4 Argon and Orchestrator (Argon), the Antigravity status line shows the Argon quota. Previously, it only showed the Claude and GPT group or the Gemini group.

Offline prices for Claude Mythos 5 and Mythos 5.2 have been added to the price table, and the price-table check now covers Mythos models as well.

items.original:
**GPT-OSS, which Antigravity retires on 2026-11-18, was removed from the Claude and GPT model group,** and Antigravity group models with hyphenated names now match your usage logs.
**Gemini 4 Carbon now shows as "Carbon 4".**
**Offline prices for Claude Mythos 5 and Mythos 5.2 were added,** and the price-table check now covers Mythos models.
**The Antigravity status line shows the Argon quota for Gemini 4 Argon and Orchestrator (Argon).** It showed the Claude and GPT group or the Gemini group instead.

title.zh-TW: 新模型偵測不再重複或漏掉提醒
title.en: New model detection stops repeating or missing alerts

body.zh-TW:
有時才剛看過新模型登場提示，轉頭用 Codex 又再跳一次；換成 Antigravity 推出新模型卻安安靜靜沒通知。

在額度感知模式下，Codex 模型目錄已經記錄過的模型，第一次實際用到時不再從用量紀錄重複提醒一次。

如果第一次掃描 Antigravity 時裡面的模型都已從其他工具認得，usage 現在會記下已經掃描過。往後有新模型出現就不會被當成第一次掃描的一部分，照樣會發出提醒。⟦點名冊就像店裡的熟客名單，以前看過的名單還會重複唱名、沒登記到的新分店又漏掉新客人，現在都只為真正第一次上門的新面孔報到。⟧
body.en:
Sometimes a new-model alert popped up again right after you used Codex, while an actual new Antigravity model triggered no notification at all.

In quota-aware mode, a model already recorded in the Codex catalog is no longer announced a second time from usage logs when you first use it.

If every model in the first Antigravity scan was already known from other tools, usage now records that the scan took place. Later new models will no longer be treated as part of that first scan and will still be announced. ⟦Think of the roster as a shop's list of regulars: names already on the list used to get called out twice, while an unregistered new branch missed its new arrivals—now only genuine first-time visitors get announced.⟧

items.original:
**Quota-aware mode no longer announces a Codex model a second time when you first use it.** A model already recorded from the Codex catalog was announced again from your usage logs.
**New Antigravity models are announced even when every model in the first scan was already known from other tools.** usage did not record that Antigravity had been scanned, so later new models were treated as part of the first scan and not announced.

title.zh-TW: NO_PROXY 排除 Google 時離線不誤判
title.en: Offline check stays accurate when NO_PROXY excludes Google

body.zh-TW: 電腦有設 proxy（代理伺服器，轉接網路連線的中繼站），又把 Google 列進不走代理的 `NO_PROXY` 名單，離線時卻被當成已登出嗎？過去即使 Google 登入主機不經由代理連線，usage 只要看到有設代理就當成有網路，結果在離線時執行 Antigravity CLI，把你標成已登出。現在 Google 登入主機被 NO_PROXY 排除時，離線檢查也會正常運作。⟦就像櫃檯看到你掛了轉接分機就當作外線暢通，沒管直撥號碼不走總機，斷線時直接誤判你離席；現在走直撥也會正常檢查離線狀態。⟧
body.en: Have a proxy (an intermediary server that forwards network connections) configured with Google listed in `NO_PROXY` to bypass it, only to be marked signed out while offline? Previously, even when Google's sign-in host bypassed the proxy, usage assumed you were online just because a proxy was set, so running the Antigravity CLI offline could mark you as signed out. Now the offline check works properly when NO_PROXY excludes Google's sign-in host. ⟦Picture a front desk assuming your outside line works just because an extension is set to forward, ignoring that direct-dial numbers bypass the switchboard and marking you away when disconnected—now direct lines get checked for offline status properly too.⟧

items.original: **The offline check works when NO_PROXY excludes Google.** With a proxy set, usage assumed it was online even when Google's sign-in host bypassed the proxy, so it could run the Antigravity CLI while offline and mark you as signed out.

title.zh-TW: Codex 額度與分支對話不再錯算重讀
title.en: Codex quotas and forked sessions stop miscounting or rereading

body.zh-TW:
只是特定模型被擋下，主畫面的週用量卻跟著跳成滿格；從對話切出去的子工作階段也每次都被重頭讀過。

當 Codex Spark 或 premium 模型這類獨立額度拒絕請求時，卡片以前會把一般週額度也標成用完。現在只有一般 Codex 額度被拒，才會顯示成 100% 已用。

重開舊的 Codex 對話工作階段後如果被拒，卡片過去會停在那個舊讀數，跳過其他工作階段較新的額度。現在會先取最新的讀數，再套用被拒紀錄。

如果你有從對話分岔出去或交給子代理的工作階段，Codex 的磁碟快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）過去每次存檔都會把它們丟掉。現在不會再漏存，也不用每次重新整理都重寫快取、重讀一次。
body.en:
A block on one specific model used to jump the main weekly usage to full, and child sessions branched off a conversation were reread from scratch every time.

When a separate limit such as Codex Spark or a premium model refused a request, the card used to mark the regular weekly quota as exhausted too. Now it only shows 100% used when the regular Codex limit is refused.

After a refusal in a reopened old Codex session, the card previously stayed on that old reading and skipped newer quota readings from other sessions. It now picks the newest reading first, then applies the refusal.

If you have forked sessions or sessions handed off to subagents, the Codex disk cache used to drop them every time it saved. They are no longer left out, avoiding rewriting the cache and rereading them on every refresh.

items.original:
**A refusal from a separate Codex limit no longer shows your regular Codex quota as 100% used.** When a dedicated limit such as Codex Spark or a premium model refused a request, the card marked the regular weekly window as full. Only a refusal of the regular Codex limit does that now.
**Reopening an old Codex session no longer hides newer quota from your other sessions.** After a refusal in a resumed old session, the card kept that session's old reading and skipped newer readings from other sessions. It now takes the newest reading, then applies the refusal.
**The Codex disk cache is no longer rewritten on every refresh when you have forked or subagent sessions.** Those sessions were dropped each time the cache was saved, so the cache was rewritten and they were read again.

title.zh-TW: 報表產生更快，記憶體不再久佔
title.en: Reports build faster without holding onto memory

body.zh-TW:
歷史紀錄越積越多，點開用量報表不只得等上一陣子，關掉後電腦記憶體還像被咬住一樣降不下來。

以前報表是在選單列或系統匣 app 裡直接產生，會把完整歷史再讀一次，讓 app 多佔約 150 MB 記憶體直到重開才會還。現在改由獨立行程產生報表，這個行程結束後就會釋放記憶體。

報表讀取速度也變快了，Claude Code 紀錄改成只讀一次，已刪除的專案資料夾也不再跑 git。一份大量歷史實測從 47 秒降到 32 秒，數字完全相同。⟦小店把算帳交給外包會計的工作室：以前厚帳本全攤在店裡櫃檯佔位子，現在帳在外面算完就收工，櫃檯立刻空出來。⟧
body.en:
As history grows, opening the usage report not only took a while, it also left your computer's memory stuck high even after closing it.

Previously, the report was built inside the menu bar or tray app, loading the full history a second time and adding about 150 MB of memory that stayed until restart. The report is now built in a separate process that frees the memory as soon as it exits.

Report loading is faster too: Claude Code logs are now read once instead of twice, and git no longer runs for deleted project folders. On one large history test, build time dropped from 47 to 32 seconds with identical numbers. ⟦A small shop now hands its bookkeeping to an outside accountant's studio: thick ledgers used to stay spread across the shop counter taking up space, whereas now the books are tallied off-site and the counter clears right away.⟧

items.original:
**Opening the report no longer leaves the menu bar or tray app about 150 MB larger.** The report was built inside the app, which loaded your full history a second time and kept that memory until restart. It is now built in a separate process that frees the memory when it exits.
**The report is built faster.** It reads Claude Code logs once instead of twice and no longer runs git for project folders that were deleted. On one large history it went from 47 to 32 seconds, with identical numbers.

title.zh-TW: 超過 30 天被刪的對話仍算活躍日
title.en: Conversations deleted after 30 days still count as active days

body.zh-TW: 每天都在用 Claude Code，回頭看報表的連續天數卻莫名其妙斷在一個月前。Claude Code 預設會在 30 天後刪除對話檔，以前那些日子就被當成沒用過，讓活躍日與連續天數跟著斷掉。現在這兩項都會算進去，熱力圖會用最淺的顏色標示。附錄也改名為「數字怎麼算的」，並在「沒算到的用量」底下把這些日期列出來。⟦跟紙本打卡單滿一個月就碎掉一樣，以前單子一銷毀就把出勤天數歸零，現在總表上仍用淡色補記一筆，全勤紀錄不會平白中斷。⟧
body.en: You use Claude Code every day, yet the streak in your report mysteriously stops a month ago. Claude Code deletes conversation files after 30 days by default, so those days used to count as unused, breaking both your active days and your streak. Now both are counted, and the heatmap marks them in its lightest shade. The appendix is also renamed to "How the numbers are calculated" and lists those dates under "Usage not included". ⟦Paper timecards used to get shredded after a month, resetting attendance counts to zero when the slips were destroyed, whereas the master sheet now adds a faint mark so a perfect attendance record is not broken for no reason.⟧

items.original: **Days you used Claude Code count as active in the report even when their conversation files are gone.** Claude Code deletes conversation files after 30 days by default, so those days counted as idle and broke your streak. Active days and streaks now count them, and the heatmap shows them in its lightest shade. The appendix, now titled "How the numbers are calculated", lists those dates under "Usage not included".

title.zh-TW: 斜線指令派工對話在報表顯示正常標題
title.en: Slash-command dispatch conversations show proper titles in the report

body.zh-TW: 翻舊紀錄想找先前派出去的任務，畫面上卻冒出「<local-command-caveat>The command below」這串字。過去根本看不出那次在忙什麼，現在用斜線指令開頭的派工對話，報表都會顯示正常的標題。
body.en: When you look through old records to find a task you previously dispatched, text like "<local-command-caveat>The command below" appears on screen. It used to be impossible to tell what that run was doing, whereas dispatch conversations starting with a slash command now display proper titles in the report.

items.original: **Dispatch conversations started with a slash command get a real title in the report** instead of text like "<local-command-caveat>The command below".

title.zh-TW: 5 小時選項改名，工作階段改稱計時器
title.en: 5-hour option renamed, changing Session to timer

body.zh-TW: 設定選單裡有個選項排在「登入時啟動」正下方，看名字常讓人以為是第二個開機啟動開關。它負責的是在額度重置後立刻開始 5 小時計時器。原名「Auto-start 5-hour Session」改為「Auto-start 5-hour timer」，名稱中的「工作階段」換成「計時器」。實際行為和你的既有設定都不會改變。
body.en: In the settings menu, an option sits right below "Launch at login", and its name often made it look like a second startup toggle. What it actually does is start the 5-hour timer right after a quota reset. Originally named "Auto-start 5-hour Session", it is renamed to "Auto-start 5-hour timer", replacing "Session" with "timer" in the name. Actual behavior and your existing settings remain unchanged.

items.original: **Auto-start 5-hour Session is renamed Auto-start 5-hour timer.** It sat under Launch at login and read like a second launch option; it starts the 5-hour timer right after a reset. Behavior and settings are unchanged.

entries: **The Codex card shows 100% used once Codex refuses a request for hitting its limit.** Current Codex CLI no longer logs quota after a refused run, so the card kept the last reading, such as 99% from hours earlier, with an "about N hours ago" warning. A refusal newer than that reading now marks the refused window as 100% used, keeps its reset time, and counts the data's age from the refusal. Once that window resets, the card goes back to the normal reading instead of moving the 100% to the other window. A refusal in another session is found even when a different session was modified more recently.

**The Set Up Status Line button now also sets up the Antigravity and Grok status lines.** The button only set up Claude Code; the Antigravity and Grok CLI status lines were added on the next app launch or by turning the status line switch off and on. They are now set up right away when those CLIs are installed, on macOS and Windows.

title.zh-TW: Codex 額度用完被拒改顯示 100%
title.en: Codex Shows 100% After Quota Refusal

body.zh-TW:
明明額度耗盡被 Codex 擋下來了，用量卡片卻還停在幾小時前的 99%，旁邊甚至掛著「約 N 小時前更新」？現在的 Codex CLI（用文字指令操作的工具）被拒後不再記下額度，卡片才一直停在最後一筆舊讀數。

現在只要有比這筆讀數更新的拒絕紀錄，被拒的那個額度窗口就會顯示 100% 已用。原本的重置時間照舊，資料新舊改從被拒那一刻算起。那個窗口重置後，卡片會回到正常讀數，不會把 100% 移到另一個窗口。

就算別的工作階段（也就是另外開的對話）比較晚修改，卡片一樣找得到另一個工作階段裡的拒絕紀錄。⟦跟信用卡刷爆被退件一樣，以前沒刷成就不記帳，帳上看起來還剩一點額度；現在只要被退刷過，這期就改標全滿，等重置後才恢復正常。⟧
body.en:
Ever get blocked by Codex after running out of quota, only for the usage card to stay stuck at 99% from hours earlier, even showing "about N hours ago" beside it? Current Codex CLI (a tool operated via text commands) no longer logs quota after a refusal, so the card kept sitting on the last old reading.

Now, whenever there is a refusal record newer than that reading, the refused quota window shows 100% used. Its original reset time stays the same, and the data's age now counts from the moment of refusal. Once that window resets, the card returns to normal readings instead of moving the 100% to the other window.

Even if a different session (a separately opened conversation) was modified more recently, the card still finds the refusal record in another session. ⟦Picture maxing out a credit card and it getting declined: before, a failed charge went unlogged so the statement still looked like it had a little room left; now, any declined attempt marks the period as full until it resets.⟧

A refusal newer than that reading now marks the refused window as 100% used, keeps its reset time, and counts the data's age from the refusal. Once that window resets, the card goes back to the normal reading instead of moving the 100% to the other window. A refusal in another session is found even when a different session was modified more recently.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列按鈕也設定 Antigravity 與 Grok
title.en: Status Line Button Also Sets Up Antigravity and Grok

body.zh-TW:
裝好 Antigravity 或 Grok CLI 後按了「設定狀態列」，這兩個工具的狀態列（顯示在終端機最底下的資訊列）以前不會當場裝上。過去這顆按鈕只設定 Claude Code，其餘兩個 CLI 得等下次重開應用程式，或把狀態列開關關掉再打開才會生效。

現在只要有裝這兩個 CLI，在 macOS 與 Windows 按下按鈕都會立刻設定好。⟦好比逛遊樂園買聯票，以前在入口蓋一次章只放行主園區，另外兩館得等下次入園或出場重進才能逛；現在只要館區有開，一蓋章就當場放行。⟧
body.en:
After installing the Antigravity or Grok CLI and clicking "Set Up Status Line", the status line (the info bar at the very bottom of the terminal) for these two tools previously would not install on the spot. In the past, that button only set up Claude Code, while the other two CLIs had to wait until the next app relaunch or for you to toggle the status line switch off and back on.

Now, as long as those two CLIs are installed, pressing the button on macOS and Windows sets them up right away. ⟦Think of buying a multi-park theme park pass: before, one stamp at the entrance only let you into the main park while the other two pavilions waited until your next visit or re-entry; now, as long as a pavilion is open, a single stamp lets you in on the spot.⟧

items.original: **The Set Up Status Line button now also sets up the Antigravity and Grok status lines.** The button only set up Claude Code; the Antigravity and Grok CLI status lines were added on the next app launch or by turning the status line switch off and on. They are now set up right away when those CLIs are installed, on macOS and Windows.

entries: **New Antigravity models are now noticed by quota-aware mode.** usage recorded Antigravity only by quota group, and those groups list broad families such as Gemini Flash and Gemini Pro, so a new model added to an existing group, like Gemini 4 Hydrogen, was never announced. Models from your Antigravity conversations are now recorded too, with effort and tier suffixes removed so each model is announced once. Antigravity models you have already used are recorded as known, so updating does not announce them as new.

**A stale-data warning no longer pushes the Settings button out of the panel.** When Claude and Codex are hidden, the Settings button moves to the Antigravity, Grok, or Muse card, and that card's "about N minutes ago" warning pushed it past the card's edge. On the card that holds the button, the warning now shows only its icons and the age moves into the ⓘ tooltip; the Antigravity title shortens if needed. The tooltip now starts with the age on every card. Reported in #341.

title.zh-TW: 額度感知模式補記 Antigravity 對話模型，同分類新品不再漏報
title.en: Quota-aware mode now records Antigravity conversation models so new ones in the same group aren't missed

body.zh-TW: 開著 usage 等新模型消息時，像 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 這類加進既有群組的新選項，過去根本不會跳通知。原本額度感知模式（偵測新模型並發送提醒的功能）只用額度池記錄 Antigravity。但額度池（只列 Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro 這類大分類的用量群組）只有粗略分類，所以加進既有額度池的新模型永遠不會被通知。現在 usage 也會記錄你在 Antigravity 對話裡用過的模型，並去掉強度與方案尾巴，讓同一個模型只通知一次。已用過的 Antigravity 模型則直接記成已知，更新後不會被當成新模型通知。⟦好比百貨樓層表以前只列「家電」「運動」大分類，舊樓層裡新開專櫃從不廣播；現在連造訪過的櫃位名稱都記下來，同區進駐新品牌才叫得出名字。⟧
body.en: When keeping usage open for news on new models, new options added to an existing group like Gemini 4 Hydrogen used to never trigger a notification. Originally, quota-aware mode (the feature that detects new models and sends alerts) recorded Antigravity only by quota group. Because quota groups (usage pools that only list broad families like Gemini Flash and Gemini Pro) only have coarse categories, any new model added to an existing group was never announced. Now usage also records models you have used in Antigravity conversations, stripping effort and tier suffixes so each model is announced only once. Antigravity models you have already used are marked as known right away, so updating won't announce them as new. ⟦Picture a department store directory that used to list only broad sections like "Appliances" and "Sports," never announcing a new counter opening on an existing floor; now it logs the names of counters you have visited, so a new brand moving into the same zone can actually be called out by name.⟧

items.original: **New Antigravity models are now noticed by quota-aware mode.** usage recorded Antigravity only by quota group, and those groups list broad families such as Gemini Flash and Gemini Pro, so a new model added to an existing group, like Gemini 4 Hydrogen, was never announced. Models from your Antigravity conversations are now recorded too, with effort and tier suffixes removed so each model is announced once. Antigravity models you have already used are recorded as known, so updating does not announce them as new.

title.zh-TW: 資料過期警告改放圖示與提示框，不再擠掉「設定」按鈕
title.en: Stale-data warning now uses icons and a tooltip so it no longer crowds out the "Settings" button

body.zh-TW: 把 usage 面板裡的 Claude 和 Codex 隱藏起來後，「設定」按鈕會移到 Antigravity、Grok 或 Muse 卡片上，原本的「約 N 分鐘前」文字卻會把按鈕推出卡片邊緣。⟦就像窄窄的櫃檯立牌硬塞進完整時間字樣，排在後面的按鈕自然被推出桌邊；現在立牌只留警告圖示，把時間收進旁邊的折疊說明卡，太長的店名必要時也縮短。⟧現在放著「設定」按鈕的那張卡片，資料過期警告只會顯示圖示，時間資訊改放進 ⓘ 提示框（滑鼠移過去才會展開的補充說明）。Antigravity 的標題在必要時也會縮短。每張卡片的 ⓘ 提示框開頭現在也都會先寫出時間。
body.en: When Claude and Codex are hidden in the usage panel, the "Settings" button moves to the Antigravity, Grok, or Muse card, where the original "about N minutes ago" text used to push the button past the card's edge. ⟦A narrow counter sign crammed with a full timestamp naturally shoves the button lined up behind it off the table's edge; now the sign keeps only the warning icon, tucks the time into the folded info card beside it, and shortens an overly long shop name if needed.⟧ On the card holding the "Settings" button, the stale-data warning now shows only icons, moving the time into the ⓘ tooltip (extra info that expands when you hover over it). The Antigravity title also shortens when needed. Every card's ⓘ tooltip now starts with the time as well.

items.original: **A stale-data warning no longer pushes the Settings button out of the panel.** When Claude and Codex are hidden, the Settings button moves to the Antigravity, Grok, or Muse card, and that card's "about N minutes ago" warning pushed it past the card's edge. On the card that holds the button, the warning now shows only its icons and the age moves into the ⓘ tooltip; the Antigravity title shortens if needed. The tooltip now starts with the age on every card. Reported in #341.

entries: **New models from Claude Code and other tools are now noticed on Windows too.** The Windows tray left out the models found in your usage logs when it recorded seen models, so quota-aware mode on Windows only announced new Codex models and Antigravity quota groups. Models you have already used are recorded as known, so updating does not announce them as new.

title.zh-TW: Windows 版也會發現 Claude Code 與其他工具的新模型
title.en: Windows now notices new models from Claude Code and other tools too

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 電腦上用這套工具追蹤各家 AI 額度時，過去並非所有工具的新模型都會跳通知。⟦跟賞鳥社團的通報一樣，以前名冊漏抄了個人日誌，只會播報兩處保護區的新鳥；現在先把日誌裡見過的鳥記成已知，其他棲地來新鳥也會通知，換新名冊後也不會重報舊鳥。⟧會這樣是因為 Windows 系統匣（桌面右下角放常駐圖示的區域）記錄看過的模型時，漏掉了用量紀錄裡的模型，因此 Windows 上的額度感知模式只會通知 Codex 新模型與 Antigravity 額度池。現在記錄看過的模型時不再漏掉用量紀錄，Windows 也會發現 Claude Code 與其他工具的新模型。你已經用過的模型會直接記成已知，更新版本後不會被當成新模型通知。
body.en: When you track AI quotas across providers with this tool on Windows, not every tool's new models used to trigger a notification. ⟦A birdwatching club's alert works the same way: previously, its roster left out personal logs and only announced new birds from two reserves; now it records birds seen in those logs as known first, so new birds from other habitats are announced too, and old birds are not reported again after switching to a new roster.⟧ This happened because the Windows system tray (the bottom-right desktop area for background icons) left out the models in your usage logs when recording seen models, so quota-aware mode on Windows only announced new Codex models and Antigravity quota groups. Now that recording seen models no longer skips your usage logs, Windows also notices new models from Claude Code and other tools. Models you have already used are recorded as known right away, so updating versions does not announce them as new.

items.original: **New models from Claude Code and other tools are now noticed on Windows too.** The Windows tray left out the models found in your usage logs when it recorded seen models, so quota-aware mode on Windows only announced new Codex models and Antigravity quota groups. Models you have already used are recorded as known, so updating does not announce them as new.

entries: **Quota-aware mode tells Claude once per conversation when new models or Antigravity quota groups appear.** When a new model or Antigravity quota group shows up in the last seven days, Claude hears about it once per conversation along with whether usage's price table knows it yet. New Codex models are picked up from Codex's own model list; models from other tools appear after you use them once.

**The Antigravity CLI recovers automatically after a temporary sign-out error.** When a background CLI check fails once with an authentication error and locks the gate, if the fallback quota check still succeeds with the same credential after six hours, usage clears the marker and resumes using the CLI.

**The Antigravity window keeper also stops launching sign-in pages after a timed-out ping.** When the auto-start ping times out while waiting on an authentication prompt, usage now records the CLI as signed out just like the quota check does.
**The Antigravity sign-out marker is now written atomically.** Concurrent reads by the window keeper can no longer see a half-written file and accidentally reopen the CLI gate.

**A Gemini weekly quota close to its reset is no longer mistaken for the 5-hour quota.** After a CLI check has recorded the weekly reset time, a fallback check whose reset estimate lands within ten minutes of that weekly reset now updates the weekly row instead of duplicating the number into the 5-hour row.

**Earlier Antigravity days in the year view update to the corrected numbers.** The saved daily history used to replace a day only when the recalculated total was at least as large, so days recorded before the Antigravity token and pricing fixes stayed stuck at the old inflated totals. After updating, those earlier days switch to the corrected numbers as long as all of that day's conversation logs and sessions are still on disk; days with missing history keep their saved totals.

**Antigravity thinking tokens are included in report totals and cost.** After output and thinking tokens were separated, Antigravity thinking tokens were left out of the report's output count and cost calculation. Thinking tokens are now billed at the output rate, matching Codex. Antigravity cost in the report will be noticeably higher: that is the share that was missing before, not a price change.

**Failed price table downloads wait 10 minutes before retrying.** When offline or behind a blocked network with an expired or missing price cache, each cost calculation started a new download attempt. usage now waits 10 minutes after a failed download before trying again.

**Replaced price tables are no longer kept in memory.** When the price table was refreshed repeatedly in a long-running menu bar session, earlier tables stayed cached in memory. usage now clears old lookup entries whenever a new price table takes effect.

**Muse Wonder and Muse Ember are priced in the HTML report.** The offline price table only knew Muse Spark, so tokens from `muse-wonder-1.0` and `muse-ember-1.0` sessions were listed as unpriced whenever the downloaded table had no Meta entries. Both now carry Meta's published standard-mode prices; Ember's long-context tier (over 200K input tokens per request) is not told apart because session logs do not record it.

**Quota-aware mode keeps working across multiple conversations on the same Claude Code account.** When another conversation on the same account updates the status file last, existing conversations still receive Claude Code quota warnings and new conversations get their starting overview without waiting. After a `/login` switch in one conversation, idle conversations that switch later no longer mistake the already-updated numbers for the old account's limits.

**Quota-aware mode handles non-ASCII text on Windows, cleans up failed state writes, and stops adding unrelated Antigravity group notes.** It now reads stdin and writes stdout as UTF-8 instead of the system code page so CJK text no longer silences it or desynchronizes saved state from output, and removes its temporary file if saving state fails. The "Other agy model groups still have quota" line now appears only on turns that actually report an Antigravity model group crossing a threshold.

**Antigravity usage is priced again in the HTML report.** The model IDs that Antigravity now records (such as `gemini-4-argon-s`, `gemini-3.8-flash-n` and `claude-sonnet-5-5-medium`) matched no entry in the price table, so all Antigravity tokens were listed as unpriced. usage now drops Antigravity's own suffixes (`-n`, `-s`, `-trial`, `-tiered`, `-low`, `-medium`, `-high`, `-xhigh`) and also looks up `gemini/`-prefixed prices. Gemini 4 Hydrogen is priced too.

**The Antigravity status line names the `xhigh` effort level.** Gemini 4 Hydrogen at `xhigh` used to show the raw English name. It now shows a localized label like the other levels, such as `Extended` in English.

**Antigravity token counts are read from the right fields.** usage added Antigravity's internal model ID (about 1,300–1,500) to the input tokens of every response, so Antigravity input was overcounted. It also swapped output and thinking tokens. Input now comes only from the input field, thinking and output are no longer swapped, and responses that carry nothing but the model ID are no longer counted. Cached Antigravity results are rebuilt once after updating.

title.zh-TW: 額度感知模式在對話中通報新模型與新額度池
title.en: Quota-aware mode announces new models and quota pools in conversations

body.zh-TW: 換上剛推出的 AI 模型趕報告，你可能會納悶 Claude 到底知不知道這個新選項。⟦就像電信公司剛推出新的漫遊方案，以前專員沒收到通報只能自己猜，現在總機會在每通來電提示一次新名稱與費率表有沒有列。⟧現在只要最近七天內出現新模型或新的 Antigravity 額度池（共用同一個用量上限的分組），額度感知模式就會在每個對話告訴 Claude 一次，並附上 usage 的價目表認不認得它。其中 Codex 的新模型會從 Codex 自己的模型清單抓到，其他工具的新模型則在你使用過一次後才會出現。當你剛試過一款新模型、接著開新對話問 Claude 目前有哪些可用額度時，它就能立刻知道這個新成員已經進來了。
body.en: When you switch to a newly released AI model to rush a report, you might wonder whether Claude even knows about this new option. ⟦Picture a telecom carrier rolling out a new roaming plan: agents used to guess without any notice, whereas now the switchboard announces the new name and whether it is on the rate sheet once on every call.⟧ Now, whenever a new model or a new Antigravity quota pool (a group sharing the same usage limit) appears within the last seven days, quota-aware mode informs Claude once per conversation and notes whether usage's price table recognizes it. New Codex models are pulled from Codex's own model list, while new models from other tools show up after you use them once. When you have just tried a new model and then open a new conversation to ask Claude what quotas are available, it will immediately know this newcomer has arrived.
